author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Fifty-Five! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

GMG Community member Gene K. Dean submitted his first ever wargame write, inspire by the OBW Challenge and the Patrons picked it for this week's entry. Love JUDGE DREDD and BLOK WARS? Played Gauntlet or any other Screen Clear video games a few decades ago? Shotgun mage is a light-hearted grid-based Arena battler for Solo play that allows you to climb to the top of the blok as one of a series of progressively more unhinged Shotgun Mages. Let's check it out!

Check out the rulebook in digital  HERE: https://www.drivethrurpg.com/en/product/555047/shotgun-mage?affiliate_id=210041
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 055 - SHOTGUN MAGE   by Gene K. Dean
